issues.detail: The admitted brochure identifies standard loader linkage, Z-bar behavior cues, cylinder counts and strokes, but not pivot coordinates, link lengths, anchor coordinates, or kinematic closure.
The standard-equipment list names standard and additional counterweight, but the publication does not separate their masses or attachment geometry.
26.5R25 (L-3) is the dimensional basis. Brand, casing profile, loaded radius, tread pitch, and inflation state are not frozen.
The 4.2 m3 stock-pile bucket, width, weight, capacity and B.O.C. basis are frozen; exact part number, shell radii, side guard and bolt pattern are not published.
